_comment: Reconstruction of the City Winery SOW. Covers the paths the CoachHub example does not: cloud_foundations (no existing GCP org), Workforce Identity Federation set up by the customer, an activation plan, partner co-investment alongside Google funding, and the Google usage-data consent paragraph.

business_challenges: Implement an agentic platform that has the ability to interact with MCP servers.
Break down data silos and increase data retrieval efficiency.

out_of_scope_extra: Development of new or custom connectors and actions, and development of any custom agents or agentic workflows.
Configuration, maintenance, or troubleshooting of production CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scripts for production.
Cleansing, normalization, deduplication, or correction of erroneous billing records or source data within BigQuery or other connected systems.
Defining, configuring, or maintaining retention policies for logs generated by the Gemini Enterprise app, or Google Cloud services, unless explicitly required for compliance within this SOW.

success_criteria: Complete end-to-end set up and system integration on Customer's Google Cloud environment with 3 connectors.
Users can effectively search and retrieve information across integrated systems.
Timely onboarding of users with 250 users onboarded using a scalable framework with minimal technical issues with adoption across the user base.
Positive customer feedback and successful handover, ensuring readiness for continued growth and collaboration.
